descriptions.preferred: The leaves of this unusual cultivar have a unique brick-red color varying during the season and with the growing conditions. Leaf margins and veins are tinged dark greenish red to almost black. The changing color in the spring is very exciting. Bright red fruits complement the leaf colors. The medium-sized leaves have seven very deeply divided lobes radiating evenly outwards like a star. Each lobe is long-ovate with a long, sharp tapering point and finely but sharply toothed margins. The red leafstalks are short and stiff. This cultivar forms an opencrowned shrub or small tree up to 23 ft. (7 m) tall. The name means "overhanging mountain. "

sources.title: 笠置山 Acer Palmatum 'Kasagi Yama'
sources.description: 最早 1978年J. D. Vertrees出版的『JAPANESE MAPLES』中开始介绍笠置山，在日本于1983年在『自然と盆栽』八月刊中岸田绿溪先生收集到的100种枫树种提到笠置山，同年在『1983秋の園芸』中开始正式销售此品种，日笠山属于大红叶系的脉斑叶品种，以7叶裂为主，春天初芽为深红色，初芽和叶柄都有白色绒毛，春叶为荧光红色并有暗红色的脉纹，春夏之际，叶子从边缘逐渐变绿，夏叶为黄绿色，秋天变为橙红色。 生长健壮，午后需要遮阴，成年株可达3米左右高度。

sources.name: Kasagiyama Pink Lace Leaf Japanese Maple
sources.description: “Kasagiyama” is known to have one of the most unusual color combinations found in japanese maples. Early spring it has a bright pink foliage, turning to brick red in the summer. It also has dark red veins in the leaf. This is a rare and very unusual cultivar and it is quite exciting to watch the new foliage. They reach about 12 feet high, and 12 ft wide.

rhs.description: Small deciduous tree about 5-6m tall, rare in cultivation. The 7-lobed leaves with sharply serrated margins are unusually coloured brick red with prominent darker veins, the colour of the leaves varying in sun or shade and the age of the leaf, and turning pink and burgundy in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一不同寻常的品种，叶片具有独特的砖红色，并会随季节变化及生长环境不同而有所变动。 叶缘与叶脉带深绿红色至近黑色调。 春季叶色的变化尤为精彩。 鲜红色的果实与叶色相映成趣。 中等大小的叶片具 7 个深裂裂片，均匀向外放射，呈星状；每个裂片为长卵形，先端渐尖而细长，边缘具细密而锐利的锯齿。 红色叶柄短而坚硬。 该品种形成开张树冠的灌木或小乔木，高可达 23 英尺（7 米）。 其名称意为“悬垂的山”。

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。
attributes.suggested_uses: 适合城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、花境及花坛。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 小型落叶乔木，高约 5-6 米，栽培中较少见。 叶片 7 裂，叶缘具锐利锯齿，叶色不同寻常，为砖红色并带明显的深色叶脉；叶色会因日照或遮阴条件以及叶龄不同而有所变化，秋季转为粉红色和酒红色。
